rationale: Price closed the day essentially flat (-0.09% vs midday) in a tightening 83,633.2-84,186.8 range, still boxed between reduceIf 82,874.5 and the twice-rejected addIf 84,944.4. Momentum keeps fading (funding down to +0.0014%, OI down to $2,384.3M, L/S ratio easing to 1.29) and the daily MACD histogram decelerated for a 7th straight session -- a genuinely low-conviction setup, not a reason to sit fully idle for a third session in a row today. Taking the defensive overnight route: a small spot DCA into the long-term core rather than any new futures exposure heading into the widest gap of the day (~6.3h to the 02:00 COT report), with the liquidation clusters at 83,500/83,250 (long side, below spot) the main overnight watch item.

message.text: Range held all day (82,874.5-84,944.4), now narrowing further (83,633.2-84,186.8). Watch 83,500/83,250 for long-liq cascades overnight if price drifts down; Sep-25 ETF flow data wasn't published yet as of this run -- check tomorrow whether the 6-day inflow streak held or broke.

lesson.pattern: Multi-session grind inside the same unbroken range with a decelerating daily MACD histogram (7 straight sessions here)
lesson.insight: When momentum fades for many sessions without a level actually breaking, small recurring DCA beats waiting indefinitely for a confirmation that keeps not arriving -- but keep sizes small since the eventual break's direction is still genuinely uncertain.
